reviews.pros:
While Navi may be regarded as one of the worst places to work, there are potential pros that can be derived from the challenging environment.
One such benefit is the opportunity for the personal growth and building resilience.
The demading nature of the work at Navi can push individuals to their limits, forcing them to develop coping mechanisms and skills to navigate high pressure situations.
reviews.cons:
The toxic and demanding nature of management, placing excessive pressure on employees to work long hours and even on weekends.
The arbitrary termination of employees without clear justification adds to an atmosphere of job insecurity.
Review system raises concern about fairness and transparency, as employee evaluations seems to heavily rely on subjective judgment from managers.
Additionally, the lack of employee care and inadequate policies addressing work-life balance indicate a disregard for employee well-being.
These cons collectively contribute to a negative workplace culture.
